This is a lesson on one drum groove the [Backing Track](../../tools/backing-track.qmd) band plays: **Hi-hat: off-beats only**. It is built up from a simpler pattern, one step at a time, and every step is played by the band and written out as it plays. How the examples work: press ▶ Play, switch players in and out with the buttons beside it, and read the band's last four bars on the staff underneath. The tempo slider at the bottom of the page slows everything down.

[All the accompaniment patterns](index.qmd) · [Drum grooves](index.qmd#drums)

## The pattern

The closed hi-hat plays only the ands, 1-and 2-and 3-and 4-and. Kick on every beat, snare on 2 and 4. In 3/4: kick on 1 and 2, snare on 3.

It belongs in *Straight-eighth rock*, *Piano ballad*, *Acoustic strum*, *Dance pop* and *Boogaloo*. Here it is in the straight-eighth rock style with the whole band. Switch the other players off to hear it alone.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="rock" data-chart="C|Am|F|G" data-tempo="112" data-on="bass comp drums congas" data-staves="drums" data-choice-label="Drum groove:" data-choices='[{"label":"Hi-hat: off-beats only","opts":{"groove":"hhoffbeats"}}]'></div>

## Step 1: Hi-hat: eighth notes

Start with something simpler. Closed hi-hat on every eighth note, all of one weight, kick on 1 and 3, snare on 2 and 4. The basic rock beat. In 3/4: six eighths, kick on 1, snare on 3.

This is a pattern of its own: [the lesson on it](drums-hheighths.qmd) takes it further. Here it is only a step on the way, slowly. The drums play alone first; switch the bass and chords on when it is steady.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="rock" data-chart="C|Am|F|G" data-tempo="78" data-on="drums" data-staves="drums" data-choice-label="Step:" data-choices='[{"label":"Hi-hat: eighth notes","opts":{"groove":"hheighths"}}]'></div>

## Step 2: Hi-hat: off-beats only, slowly

Now the pattern itself. Compare it with the step before: press each button while the band plays and watch what changes on the staff.

**How to play it.** The hi-hat only on the ands, the kick on every beat, the snare on 2 and 4. The hand fills in between the foot.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="rock" data-chart="C|Am|F|G" data-tempo="78" data-on="drums" data-staves="drums" data-choice-label="Compare:" data-choices='[{"label":"Hi-hat: off-beats only","opts":{"groove":"hhoffbeats"}},{"label":"Hi-hat: eighth notes (the step before)","opts":{"groove":"hheighths"}}]'></div>

## Step 3: Up to tempo, with the band

The whole band, at 112 beats a minute. Play along, then switch the band's drum kit off and take the part yourself.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="rock" data-chart="C|Am|F|G" data-tempo="112" data-on="bass comp drums congas" data-staves="drums bass" data-choice-label="Drum groove:" data-choices='[{"label":"Hi-hat: off-beats only","opts":{"groove":"hhoffbeats"}}]'></div>

## Step 4: In 3/4

The same pattern in a waltz: three beats to the bar. Listen for what it keeps and what it drops when the bar is a beat shorter.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="rock" data-chart="C|C|F|F|G7|G7|C|C" data-tempo="120" data-on="bass comp drums congas" data-staves="drums" data-meter="3/4" data-choice-label="Drum groove:" data-choices='[{"label":"Hi-hat: off-beats only","opts":{"groove":"hhoffbeats"}}]'></div>

## How it relates to the other patterns

- **Leads to:** [Hi-hat: open off-beats](drums-hhdance.qmd): the patterns that use this one as a step.
- **The same idea elsewhere in the band:** [Every off-beat](chords-upbeats.qmd) (comping rhythm), [Reggae one-drop](drums-onedrop.qmd) (drum groove), [Calypso](drums-calypso.qmd) (drum groove).
- **Plays with, in straight-eighth rock:** [Root eighths](bass-eighths.qmd) (bass line), [Strum: down-up eighths](chords-strum-eights.qmd) (comping rhythm).
- **Other drum grooves in the Folk, rock and pop group:** [Bo Diddley beat](drums-bodiddley.qmd), [Waltz in one](drums-waltz.qmd), [Two-beat](drums-boomchick.qmd), [Rock backbeat](drums-rock.qmd), [Pop backbeat](drums-strum.qmd), [Ballad](drums-ballad.qmd), [Four on the floor](drums-dance.qmd), [Motown](drums-motown.qmd).
